messages:
Maya (CSM): FYI BeaconOps reached out — they want to add two new teams (Data Science + Field Ops). Estimating ~3x API QPS during peak next month. Asking about Dedicated capacity + onboarding timeline. Could be an expansion ahead of renewal. @Riley any renewal flags?

Riley (AE): Renewal due 2026-09 but no add-ons yet. Good upsell motion if we can prove perf & cost. I'll start a pilot quote. :moneybag: Please capture expected ARR uplift — I think ~+20% if both teams go live.

Leo (SE): Need telemetry to size Dedicated properly. Can you share recent 24h request shape, avg seq len, and % of streaming vs non-streaming? Bursty chat traffic behaves very differently.

Maya (CSM): Link to their internal dashboard (redwood-internal): https://dashboards.internal/beaconops/usage — copied snippet below (sanitized):

```
24h peak qps: 120 -> expected 360
avg tokens/request: 420
% streaming: 78%
typical prompt prefix: large system prompt (~800 tokens)
```

ops-bot: Billing threshold alert for account beaconops — usage at 104% of monthly commit.

Aisha (Onboard PM): I can run a 90-min ops + developer workshop and a quick runbook for their infra team. Available Wed/Thu next week. I also need staging tokens and a sanitized payload sample to validate configs.

Leo (SE): From that snippet it looks like long system prompts + streaming chat — priority is: 1) enable prefix/KV cache, 2) tune batching (smaller batches for streaming), 3) consider quantized model variant on Dedicated to cut cost. Example quick config we use for similar customers: 

```
--max-batch=8
--streaming-prefetch=2
--kv-cache=on
model: rwinf-base-q4_1
```

Maya (CSM): Proposed next steps:
1) Riley: draft pilot pricing & send to BeaconOps contact today
2) Leo: produce a short config template + perf estimate (include latency SLOs)
3) Aisha: schedule onboarding/workshop + deliver runbook checklist
4) I'll assemble customer-facing kickoff + success metrics (latency < 200ms p95, error rate < 0.5%) and loop in Legal for pilot T&Cs.

Riley (AE): On it — I'll have a draft quote by EOD and loop in Finance for PO flow. tagging @finance for any PO requirements.

Aisha (Onboard PM): If they accept pilot, we'll need staging tokens, read-only access to request logs, and a contact for deployment windows. I'll DM a checklist after the quote.

Leo (SE): I can simulate their workload on a Dedicated node once I get a sanitized sample payload. @Maya can you request that from Evan? Also I'll include a short perf run and expected cost delta vs hosted path.

Maya (CSM): Noting renewal impact: medium risk if we miss latency targets, high upside if pilot proves out. I'll surface this to Customer Success leadership and add to the quarterly renewal dashboard.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: BeaconOps pilot kickoff — 2026-05-12 10:00 (created by maya_csm).

Riley (AE): Ack. :thumbsup:

Maya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll update the thread when Evan sends the sample and confirm workshop times.

Leo (SE): Thanks — will prep template and perf script.

Aisha (Onboard PM): Sending checklist shortly.
